name: P15 spell VFX + shake + victory tally

steps.note: 1. Start a fight on the Long Lane and wait for the command window.

steps.msg: FX pools are attached to the battle stage

steps.note: 2. Fire Scorcha through the presenter — must draw fire_burst and bump the shake.

steps.eval: (()=>{ window.__fx0 = (__DQ.state().fx && __DQ.state().fx.played) || 0; window.__bp0 = (__DQ.state().battlePresent && __DQ.state().battlePresent.fx && __DQ.state().battlePresent.fx.played) || 0; const foes = (__DQ.state().battle && __DQ.state().battle.enemies) || []; const tgt = foes[0] && foes[0].id; const party = (__DQ.state().battle && __DQ.state().battle.party) || []; const actor = (party.find(p=>p.id==='willow')||party[0]||{}).id; return __DQ.battlePlay({ t:'act', actor, kind:'spell', spell:'scorcha', element:'fire', target: tgt }); })()

steps.msg: present.js called FX.play for the spell
a damage spell shakes the battle camera

steps.note: 3. Heavy Kascorcha + Bus fx.shake path — WEIGHT.

steps.eval: (()=>{ window.__sh0 = __DQ.state().battlePresent.camera.shake; return __DQ.battlePlay({ t:'act', actor:'willow', kind:'spell', spell:'kascorcha', element:'fire', target: ((__DQ.state().battle.enemies||[])[0]||{}).id }); })()

(()=>{ if (window.__DQ && __DQ.Bus) __DQ.Bus.emit('fx.shake', {amp:0.6, ms:200}); else if (__DQ.state) { /* Bus may be under ctx */ } try { const B = (window.__bus) || null; return 'ok'; } catch(e){ return String(e);} })()

steps.note: 4. Buff aura Bolster — the gap that said present never calls FX.

steps.eval: __DQ.battlePlay({ t:'act', actor:'sera', kind:'spell', spell:'bolster', element:'buff', target:'bram' })

steps.note: 5. Play the rest out — victory tally must still be a moment.

steps.msg: victory is a window of its own
EXP counts up inside the victory window
back on the field after the victory
FX pools re-attached to the field after battle
